title: ImplementationReport
description: The Implementer's account of one implementation round: which tests prove each acceptance criterion, what it ran, what it changed, and what it is unsure about. The orchestrator reads `criteria` for the ac_test_mapping check and verifies every named test against its own test reports and e2e results; everything else is a hypothesis for the reviewer to test.

head_sha.description: The pushed commit this report describes.

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion in the spec, in order.

tests.description: Test ids exactly as the orchestrator's own run reports them. pytest: node ids as `pytest --collect-only -q` prints them (tests/test_x.py::test_name, tests/test_x.py::TestClass::test_name, tests/test_x.py::test_name[param]). Bun: `path/to/x.test.ts::outer describe > inner describe > test name` (file relative to the repository root, describe blocks outermost first, the test name as Bun reports it, test.each names expanded), counted only from a direct `bun test ...` test_plan command. A file, pytest class or Bun describe id covers every test under it. Empty only for a criterion whose verification is not automated_test. A controller-run e2e journey can be referenced as e2e:<zero-based index>, such as e2e:0 for test_plan.e2e[0]. That entry must declare this criterion in covers_ac and pass with all required visual evidence.

red_on_base.description: Whether the named tests were seen failing on base_sha (rubric I1 level 3).

commands_run.description: Every test_plan.commands entry, as run from a clean state before finishing.

summary.description: The command's own summary line, e.g. '29 passed in 1.2s'.

exit_code.description: null when the entry was not run (no preview yet).

test_concerns.description: Existing tests the implementer believes are wrong; it never edits them.
